datasets.title: NASA PCoE Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) Composites
datasets.publication_or_citation: Abhinav Saxena, Kai Goebel, Cecilia C. Larrosa, Fu-Kuo Chang, CFRP Composites Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository.
datasets.provider: Stanford Structures and Composites Laboratory in collaboration with NASA Ames PCoE

verified_metadata.sensing: 16-channel PZT Lamb-wave network and multiple triaxial strain gauges

limitations: Panel/layup/run-specific; X-ray damage truth is periodic rather than continuously observed.
The landing page lists a download and citation but does not establish a dataset-specific reuse license.
NASA's general science-data policy says non-NASA-led/provider data may be supplied as-is; source rights must be checked with the originating provider.

rights.notes: Do not infer CC0 from NASA hosting. Confirm provider-originated rights and any third-party restrictions before reuse, redistribution or public leaderboard inclusion.

security.required_handling: Hash and inspect the archive before extraction; perform bounded extraction in an isolated workspace.

datasets.publication_or_citation: Marzani et al., An open database for benchmarking guided waves structural health monitoring algorithms on a composite full-scale outer wing demonstrator, Structural Health Monitoring, DOI 10.1177/1475921719889029.

verified_metadata.structure: composite panel closing the bottom of a full-scale outer-wing demonstrator
verified_metadata.sensor_health: electromechanical impedance checks for transducer reliability and bond strength

limitations: A full-scale demonstrator/test article, not an in-service aircraft fleet or type-qualified structure.
The paper describes the database as freely available, but dataset-specific licensing and redistribution conditions must be recorded independently.
Damage localization/sizing claims must remain within the published article's ground-truth and test-stage scope.

rights.notes: The article's free-availability statement is not a substitute for a machine-readable dataset license or redistribution grant; check the host's current terms.

security.required_handling: Inspect file formats, metadata, archive paths and size before processing; preserve source bytes and hashes.

datasets.title: Dataset on guided waves from long-term SHM under uncontrolled and dynamic conditions
datasets.publication_or_citation: Yang et al., Scientific Data 12, 991 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41597-025-05300-5; data DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28112504.

verified_metadata.dataset_license_metadata: CC BY reported by DataCite/OpenAIRE metadata for DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28112504; direct item-level Figshare licence still requires confirmation

limitations: The structure is an aluminum plate, not an aerospace composite; use for environmental/sensor/installation drift rather than direct aircraft transfer claims.
The published data are downsampled and trimmed relative to the original acquisition: approximately one of every 20 original measurements and 2,000 of 10,000 samples per wave.
The published repository README says to use the current Figshare link because the original dataset link is no longer available.
Data are Python pickle files; standard unpickling can execute arbitrary code. Never deserialize directly on developer workstations or CI.

rights.notes: DataCite/OpenAIRE metadata reports CC BY for the dataset record. This is stronger than an assumed Figshare default, but the direct item-level Figshare license and version metadata must still be checked before reuse or redistribution. The journal article itself has a separate CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license; do not conflate article and dataset rights. No download or adaptation has occurred.

security.required_handling: Do not unpickle on a developer workstation or CI. Verify source and digest; if conversion is necessary, use a disposable network-isolated sandbox with no credentials, no writable host mounts, resource limits and a constrained converter. Prefer a safe, documented columnar interchange output with its own digest and provenance.
